title: Testing and shipping: how the cut was proved

cards.title: Prove a change, then ship it
cards.text: Goldens that show nothing moved but what was meant, rules held by tests, and a merge that ships itself.

cards.title: Goldens as a refactor's proof
cards.text: What the model reads pinned before the cut, and the same after it, but for what was meant.

cards.title: Rules a person can maintain
cards.text: A composition root tested alone, ratchets that only shrink, docs held to the code.

cards.title: Shipping by place
cards.text: Config and Docker per place, Azure as one file, a green main deploys both apps.

cards.title: Proved with numbers, switched in one step
cards.text: A new layout built beside the old, measured, then switched in one commit.

cards.title: A site held to the code
cards.text: Pages a crawler can read, facts a search engine reads, a site held to the solution.
